summary_short.zh: authentik 是一款开源身份提供商，集中管理各应用的身份验证与授权，消除分散的登录系统和混乱的访问策略。其技术核心在于灵活可配置的登录、注册及多因素认证流程，支持 OIDC/OAuth2 协议，并原生集成 Kubernetes。用户可通过 Docker 或 Helm 部署，借助代理或 SSO 端点连接现有应用，定制实际访问控制流程。

summaries.en: authentik is an open-source identity provider that centralizes authentication and authorization across your applications, eliminating scattered login systems and inconsistent access policies. Its key technical strength lies in flexible, configurable flows for login, registration, and MFA, paired with OIDC/OAuth2 support and native Kubernetes integration. You can deploy it via Docker or Helm, connect existing apps through its proxy or SSO endpoints, and customize flows for real-world access control.

summary_short.zh: celld 是 Deno 团队开源的分布式 Durable Objects 运行时，让开发者能自托管 Cloudflare 风格的有状态无服务器应用。它用 Rust 编写，核心思路是把“状态+逻辑”封装成一个可寻址对象，由某个节点唯一持有并处理请求；节点故障时自动迁移，从而在分布环境下简化一致性问题。这种设计兼顾强一致与低延迟，尤其适合状态密集、需要协同的场景。你可以使用 celld 自建多人游戏后端、实时协作编辑器或物联网控制平台，既保留数据主权，又获得类似云厂商的 Durable Objects 体验。

summaries.zh: celld 是 Deno 团队开源的分布式 Durable Objects 运行时，让开发者能自托管 Cloudflare 风格的有状态无服务器应用。它用 Rust 编写，核心思路是把“状态+逻辑”封装成一个可寻址对象，由某个节点唯一持有并处理请求；节点故障时自动迁移，从而在分布环境下简化一致性问题。这种设计兼顾强一致与低延迟，尤其适合状态密集、需要协同的场景。你可以使用 celld 自建多人游戏后端、实时协作编辑器或物联网控制平台，既保留数据主权，又获得类似云厂商的 Durable Objects 体验。
summaries.en: celld is a self-hosted, distributed Durable Objects runtime that brings Cloudflare-style stateful serverless compute to your own infrastructure. Built in Rust, it provides a lightweight coordination, replication, and storage layer, so you can build strongly consistent, location-aware services without managing complex distributed systems. Its core design treats each unit of state and logic as a movable, addressable object owned by a single node at a time, with automatic failover. That simplifies consistency and enables low-latency access. You can use celld for multiplayer backends, collaborative editing, or IoT coordination on hardware you control.
